note: Every triple in assets/registry/triples.json needs a line here (key: "Base + Tint + Second"), or the site build fails. What the triple adds on top of its pair.
Fire + Cold + Lightning: A short lightning arc: Burning jumps to one more adjacent enemy.
Fire + Cold + Blood: A burn from within: the Burning damage grows with every tick.
Fire + Cold + Blunt: The blow breaks the guard and knocks the target back one cell; it is off guard (its defense is divided) for a while.
Fire + Cold + Piercing: The target is Sundered: its armor against Piercing is divided (about half).
Fire + Lightning + Cold: Frost: the target and the enemy the burn jumped to are Slowed and Blinded (their d20 is divided).
Fire + Lightning + Blood: The jump becomes a blood lightning: Bleeding lands and jumps too, and the neighbours take a share of the damage.
Fire + Lightning + Blunt: A chance to stun with the Burning, the Stun jumps to a neighbour, and the target is knocked back one cell.
Fire + Lightning + Piercing: The target (and the neighbour) are Exposed to crits, and a crit always ignites.
Fire + Blood + Cold: Bleeding ticks slower; the target is Slowed and Rooted.
Fire + Blood + Lightning: Shock lands and jumps to every bleeding enemy within 2 cells.
Fire + Blood + Blunt: Stun lands; Bleeding is refreshed and stronger.
Fire + Blood + Piercing: Bleeding deals its damage twice per turn.
Fire + Blunt + Cold: After the knockback the target slides: Slowed and off guard.
Fire + Blunt + Lightning: Shock lands and jumps to every burning enemy within 2 cells.
Fire + Blunt + Blood: The knocked-back target leaves a bloody trail: Weakened and bleeding.
Fire + Blunt + Piercing: The target flies 2 cells and gets Penetration.
Fire + Piercing + Cold: An ice plug in the wound: the target is Slowed and Vulnerable, so the next hit hurts more.
Fire + Piercing + Lightning: Shock lands; the Burning of a crit also reaches a neighbour.
Fire + Piercing + Blunt: The target is Dazed: it uses no reactive skill.
Cold + Fire + Lightning: The damage of the thawing Freeze also hits all neighbours (dealt at once).
Cold + Fire + Blood: Weakening now; Bleeding starts only after the thaw.
Cold + Fire + Blunt: Stun, and extra damage from the broken ice against a frozen target.
Cold + Fire + Piercing: The target is so Exposed that the next hit crits almost surely.
Cold + Lightning + Fire: Thermal shock: the neighbours take damage, and a weak Burning jumps to one of them.
Cold + Lightning + Blood: The freeze jumps further (to the enemy behind), and everyone it reaches is Weakened.
Cold + Lightning + Blunt: Stun; if the target was frozen, the shards hurt every enemy next to it.
Cold + Lightning + Piercing: The target and the enemy the freeze jumped to are Exposed to crits.
Cold + Blood + Fire: The Weakening is taken off, but a weak Burning appears.
Cold + Blood + Lightning: Shock chains to every enemy within 2 cells, and all of them are Weakened.
Cold + Blood + Blunt: Stun lasts longer, and a Slow remains after it.
Cold + Blood + Piercing: Bleeding starts only when the target thaws, and hits harder.
Cold + Blunt + Fire: Thermal shock (more damage) and a weak Burning on the target.
Cold + Blunt + Lightning: Shock, and the shards hurt the neighbours.
Cold + Blunt + Piercing: Penetration, and the hit is a certain crit against a frozen target.
Cold + Piercing + Fire: When the target thaws it takes damage and a weak Burning.
Cold + Piercing + Lightning: The Freeze jumps to a neighbour, and Shock lands.
Cold + Piercing + Blood: Strong Bleeding after the thaw, and a Weakening that lasts past it.
Cold + Piercing + Blunt: The ice cracks and the target is stunned.
Lightning + Fire + Cold: A Slow, and the Burning ticks less often but longer.
